title: One Time mobile CRM information architecture

reasons: The source statement explicitly requires a focused Product Quality packet before broad CRM UI edits.
The work changes app-visible CRM mobile IA and must preserve workspace isolation and no-send action states.
Current-state screenshots and a state matrix are mandatory before implementation.
affected_product_surfaces: Operations One Time CRM contact workspace
likely_external_provider_blockers: Owner-only email/WhatsApp sends remain blocked under REQ-20260713-906 and are out of scope.
recommended_packet_sequence: Use current-state audit AUDIT-20260713-909 as before evidence.
Implement only mobile CRM IA state boundaries and responsive layout behavior.
Run local smoke with 390/430 mobile list/detail/back/subview/action states.
Run action, protocol, execution-run, and exact deploy/live smoke gates before Done.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: Implement REQ-20260713-909 only; do not send email/WhatsApp, activate public auto-reply, or broaden BNA frontend parity.

operator_intent_summary: Redesign the One Time CRM contact workspace mobile IA from an always-open wall of sections into explicit list, detail, subview, and action states with a focused contact header, section rail, contextual overflow, lazy section data, stable URL/back behavior, accessibility, and responsive proof.
raw_quotes: The CRM contact workspace needs a focused Product Quality packet before broad UI edits; mobile must use list, detail, and subview/action states with a focused contact header, section rail, contextual overflow, lazy section data, URL state, accessibility, and responsive visual proof.

decisions_captured.decision: One Time is the implementation and acceptance target for this phase.
Simultaneous BNA frontend parity is superseded for this phase; BNA checks are regression safety only.
Owner-only communication tests require secure aliases and are out of scope for mobile CRM IA.

out_of_scope: No email, WhatsApp, Telegram, payment, access grant, DNS, provider-account, production-data, GHL, LeadConnector, or external CRM writes.
No public WhatsApp auto-reply activation and no owner-test sends.
No broad BNA frontend parity implementation in this packet.
No CRM backend schema/data migration unless a minimal shared-runtime safety fix is required and separately verified.
No redesign of public landing, provider mailbox, communications, signup, classroom, or member portal surfaces.
affected_surfaces: Operations One Time CRM contact workspace

expanded_phrases.CRM: One Time scoped first-party contact workspace with explicit list, selected-detail, subview, action-overflow, empty, error, permission, and mobile back-restored states; not a generic all-in-one wall of panels.
expanded_phrases.mobile: 390px and 430px single-pane One Time CRM flow with one primary state visible at a time, 40px minimum controls, stable back behavior, and no horizontal overflow.
expanded_phrases.information architecture: Named mobile states, route entry points, expected content, actions, accessibility semantics, screenshot proof, and no-send/privacy constraints for the One Time CRM contact workspace.
expanded_phrases.focused contact workspace: A selected-contact view with a concise header, summary metadata, section rail, contextual action overflow, and lazy detail panels instead of showing every CRM section at once.
expanded_phrases.professional: Predictable, accessible, workspace-scoped operator UI with stable dimensions, clear states, and verified route/action behavior.
expanded_phrases.clean: No internal debug copy, no duplicate controls, no wrong-workspace data, no unnecessary eager sections, no overflow, and no unregistered business actions.
expanded_phrases.make it work: Persist existing URL/back/search/filter/list-scroll behavior and verify it through local and live smoke tests before marking Done.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: CRM means the existing first-party BNA/One Time contact workspace, not GHL, LeadConnector, or another external CRM runtime.

requirements.statement: Create explicit CRM mobile list, detail, subview, and action-overflow states.
requirements.expected_result: Only one primary mobile state is visible at a time and the selected contact header remains focused.
Back to contacts restores prior list context and browser Back keeps route state predictable.

requirements.statement: Lazy-load or lazy-render section data by active subview.
requirements.expected_result: Inactive heavy sections do not expand the mobile DOM or trigger unnecessary data fetches.

requirements.statement: Keep no-send/privacy/workspace-scope guardrails visible and enforced.
requirements.expected_result: One Time scope remains isolated and write/send actions stay explicit, registered, and approval-gated.

requirements.statement: Produce responsive visual, accessibility, and action-state evidence.
requirements.expected_result: 390/430/768/1440 screenshots, focus/ARIA checks, action registry watchdog, and live smoke evidence exist before Done.

criteria: PQC validator passes for this packet before app-visible UI edits.
Affected route scope is limited to the One Time Operations CRM contact workspace split shell and monolith fallback.
State matrix includes loading, empty, populated, filtered_empty, error, blocked_setup, preview_only, success_readback, permission_denied, and mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.
External sends, payments, access grants, provider-account mutations, external CRM writes, and production data mutations are explicitly out of scope.
